Gratefuly Journal

Start each day with gratitude. Gratefuly Journal is a beautiful, private journal that helps you build the habit of noticing the good in your life — in just 2 minutes a day. Every day brings a new writing prompt, mood tracking, streaks, and rich media entries with photos, voice recordings, and videos. Everything stays on your device — no account required, no cloud uploads.
